narratives.Overview:
# Next-build (recut Bound remedy)

Filed Wanted 1 "Reuse #1378 fields if that is clean" is REJECTED. Dispatch-cohort consent and close-unit consent stay distinct. `cohort_vbriefs` is the dispatch set, not a close grant. `--allow-close` is not one-PR-unit consent. Do not parse an implement list or free-form issue/comment text as the mint.

Keep one-PR batching. Make it explicit. Default without a one-PR-unit grant: one origin → one PR.

## Bound remedy

1. Distinct one-PR-unit identity. Do not reuse #1378 `allocation_plan_id` / `batching_rationale` / `operator_approval_evidence`.
2. Operator-origin mint: approval reference, rationale, exact normalized `(repo, issue-id)` set, and branch/PR-unit binding or single-use claim. Envelope and CLI carry only its identifier. Exact-set equality (not authz overlap). Independent of UAT mode.
3. One decision procedure, composed: forge closing references (including `Closes #4204, #4218, …`) at `pr-closeout-attestable`; same decision at story-ready for a declared multi-origin unit; same validator at pre-PR / `pr:check-closing-keywords`; `scope:complete` rechecks for lifecycle consistency only.
4. Flip automated `pr:check-closing-keywords` invocations (`task check` graph and branch-gate) from `--mode fp` to `--mode both`.
5. Implement-class `solo` with `|cohort_vbriefs| > 1` and no one-PR-unit grant is a config error. Overlap serializes N PRs. File overlap / missing swarm metadata / `parallel_safe: false` / `swarm:readiness` refusing concurrent workers / “swarm if possible” are NOT close-permission.
6. Docs: on `swarm:readiness` failure / Phase 0 exit, print serialize-N-PRs. Close-surface docs live next to the github.md single-purpose line. Phase 0 Step 3 “no hardcoded 1:1 rule” and github.md “one cohesive change” must not be readable as silent combine. #3666 solo path: N=1 per origin unless the closed one-PR-unit form exists.

Citing lean 5655867921 and synthesis 5655871094.
